summary: When stdout is returned, Ansible also provides stdout_lines, a list of strings with one item per output line.
questions: How do I iterate over each line of command output?
What's the difference between stdout and stdout_lines?

answer_card.title: stdout_lines return value
answer_card.answer_md:
**`stdout_lines`** is `stdout` split into a list of lines:

```yaml
- debug: msg="{{ item }}"
  loop: "{{ r.stdout_lines }}"
```
